title: Keyboard Manager: Remapped Copilot key (F23) not recognized in Citrix Workspace session

status.label: Needs native Citrix trace
status.detail: The remap works locally and in Citrix HTML5 but fails in native Citrix Workspace; event evidence is needed to determine ownership.

next_action.label: Request native Citrix diagnostics
next_action.reason: Compare native windowed/full-screen sessions with the working browser client.

judgment.rationale: The detailed client comparison implicates native Citrix keyboard handling, but a diagnostic/event capture is still required to determine whether PowerToys emits the intended replacement.
evidence: The remap works locally and in Citrix HTML5 through Edge.
Native Citrix Workspace 25.8.10.36 ignores the remap.
TransparentKeyPassthrough=Local changes behavior but breaks remote Alt+Tab.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a fresh native-Citrix diagnostic archive and exact remote event result.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys compatibility correction is possible, but native Citrix event filtering remains the stronger competing explanation.

proposed_fixes.title: Determine native Citrix compatibility for injected Right Ctrl
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Native Citrix may filter the injected Right Ctrl sequence or expose residual Win/Shift/F23 state that the browser client tolerates.
plan: Capture local and remote event sequences in native windowed/full-screen Citrix and HTML5.
Implement a targeted state/order correction only if PowerToys emits an incorrect stream.
verification: Confirm one Right Ctrl sequence without original modifiers in all supported modes.

confidence.rationale: The browser/native split is strong transport evidence, but the local injected stream is not captured.

issue_context.summary: The Copilot/F23 remap works locally and in Citrix HTML5 but is ignored by native Citrix Workspace.
known_information: Reported PowerToys version is 0.97.1 on Windows 11 build 26100.
Native Citrix fails while Citrix HTML5 succeeds.
TransparentKeyPassthrough=Local makes the remap work but changes Alt+Tab behavior.
inferences: Native Citrix capture or filtering is a stronger suspect than the mapping configuration.
PowerToys modifier ordering still needs to be ruled out.
issue_context.analysis: A windowed/full-screen native trace compared with HTML5 is the decisive next evidence.
initial_investigation: Keyboard Manager emits the replacement through KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp and Helpers.cpp.
Issues #21258 and #30695 show related remote transport differences.

information_gaps.information: Native Citrix event output in windowed and full-screen modes with the current passthrough setting.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes PowerToys state/injection behavior from Citrix filtering.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce both modes, report the exact remote event, and comment /bugreport immediately afterward.

actions.label: Approve Citrix compatibility investigation
actions.design_summary: Compare PowerToys event generation with native Citrix transport and correct only confirmed modifier or event-order defects.

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming that the remap works locally and in Citrix HTML5 but still fails in native Citrix Workspace. Please provide:

1. A fresh diagnostic archive by commenting `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing in native Citrix.
2. Whether the session is windowed or full-screen and the current TransparentKeyPassthrough setting.
3. What the remote session receives: no event, the original Copilot behavior, Right Ctrl, or Win/Shift/F23.
4. If possible, one windowed and one full-screen comparison.

This will determine whether a PowerToys code change is applicable or the limitation is in native Citrix transport.
